description: This Java class 'ServiceXaWrapper' is an XA resource wrapper for managing transactional service calls with commit and rollback capabilities, including asynchronous execution and transaction suspension/resumption.

classes.name: ServiceXaWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper for XA transactions that manages service execution during commit and rollback, supporting asynchronous and synchronous modes, with transaction suspension and resumption.

methods.name: setCommitService
methods.description: Sets the service to run on transaction commit, with optional user and context.

methods.name: getCommitService
methods.description: Returns the name of the service to run on commit.

methods.name: getCommitContext
methods.description: Returns the context used when running the commit service.

methods.name: setRollbackService
methods.description: Sets the service to run on transaction rollback, with optional user and context.

methods.name: getRollbackService
methods.description: Returns the name of the service to run on rollback.

methods.name: getRollbackContext
methods.description: Returns the context used when running the rollback service.

methods.name: enlist
methods.description: Enlists the resource in the current transaction, with verbose logging.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Performs commit operation by invoking the configured commit service asynchronously.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Performs rollback operation by invoking the configured rollback service asynchronously.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the transaction for two-phase commit, with verbose logging.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Executes a service call within a suspended transaction, handling transaction suspension, service invocation, and resumption.
